[[Raisu Palace (outpost)|Raisu Palace]] | pic1 = [[File:Raisu Pavilion map.jpg|200px]] | pic1-text = Raisu Pavilion | ingame name=Raisu Pavilion | game link type 0=explorable | game link num 0=301 }} [[Raisu Pavilion]] is the entrance to the grand [[Raisu Palace (outpost)|Raisu Palace]]. Despite the palace being blocked off to players early on, this area is available immediately. This explorable area is very small and, unlike all the other areas you can visit early in the game, Raisu Pavilion is themed to Raisu Palace rather than the actual city. ==Exits== *[[Kaineng Center]] (west) *[[Raisu Palace (outpost)|Raisu Palace]] (east) (only after [[Taking Back the Palace]]) ==Shrines== There are no [[resurrection shrine]]s in this area. ==Quests available== *[[Emperor's Hand]] **[[Battle in the Sewers]] {{quest icon|primary}} **[[Captured]] **[[Naga Oil]] **[[Street Justice]] ==NPCs== ===Allies=== *{{x}} 20 [[Palace Guard Tsungkim]] *{{x}} 10 (20) [[Emperor's Hand]] *{{x}} 10 [[Minister Tao]] *{{x}} 10 (20) [[Minister Jaisan]] *{{x}} 10 [[Attendant Hara]] ==Notes== *The only quests that will affect the [[spawn]]s in this area are [[City Under Attack]] and [[Vassal States]]. *As there are no foes, this area cannot be [[Vanquisher|vanquished]]. *Complete exploration of this explorable area contributes approximately 0.1% to the Canthan [[Cartographer]] title. {{Explorable areas in Kaineng City}} [[de:Raisu-Pavillion]]
